The observation shows unrelated artifacts or lines were modified.

new.name: CONDUCTS_RESIDUAL_RISK_SWEEP
new.definition: Motivated by residual risk, the reasoning calls for a broad search for overlooked instances beyond the already identified targets; the action scans multiple locations or patterns; and the observation is interpreted to rule out additional actionable cases or to identify them.

parameters.name: sweep_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning motivating a broad search for overlooked instances after targeted work.

parameters.name: sweep_action
parameters.description: The action scanning locations, patterns, or artifact types beyond the known targets.

parameters.name: sweep_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting whether additional actionable instances were found.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning motivates a broad search for overlooked instances after targeted work.
The action searches across a wider set of locations, patterns, or artifact types than the known targets.
The observation is examined for additional actionable instances and either reveals none or identifies new ones.
exclusion_conditions: The action only rechecks the already known target values.
No broader residual-risk search is motivated.
The observation is not interpreted for overlooked instances.

new.name: PERSISTS_ACCEPTED_CHANGES_WITH_VERSION_CONTROL
new.definition: An action records a set of accepted changes in a version-control commit, and the observation reports the created commit together with the changed set.

parameters.name: persistence_action
parameters.description: The action that creates a version-control commit from the accepted changes.

parameters.name: commit_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the created commit and its changed set.

assertion_conditions: The action creates a version-control commit from the accepted changes.
The observed result reports a commit identifier, commit summary, or changed-file summary consistent with the intended changes.
exclusion_conditions: The action does not create a version-control commit.
The observation only states that a commit was attempted without reporting its result.
The commit includes changes unrelated to the accepted set.

new.name: APPLIES_CONSISTENT_CANONICAL_REPLACEMENT
new.definition: The reasoning recognizes multiple distinct occurrences or values that belong to the same category and mandates a single canonical replacement for all of them in order to satisfy a cross-artifact consistency requirement.

parameters.name: consistency_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning recognizing multiple occurrences and requiring one canonical replacement for consistency.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies at least two distinct values or occurrences that are to be replaced.
The reasoning requires that they map to one common canonical replacement.
The reasoning cites cross-artifact consistency as the reason for the common mapping.
exclusion_conditions: Only one occurrence or value is being replaced.
Different replacements are assigned without a consistency requirement.
No cross-artifact consistency constraint is invoked.

uncertain.name: TESTS_UNCERTAINTY_WITH_PROBE
uncertain.definition: The reasoning identifies a specific unresolved question about system state, a targeted action queries that state, and the resulting observation supplies evidence relevant to resolving the question.

parameters.name: uncertainty_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning stating the specific uncertainty or assumption to be checked.

parameters.name: probe_action
parameters.description: The action directed at obtaining information about the stated uncertainty.

parameters.name: probe_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the result relevant to the uncertainty.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states a specific uncertainty or assumption to be checked.
The action is directed at obtaining information about that uncertainty rather than performing an unrelated change.
The observation reports a result that can be interpreted as evidence about the uncertainty.
exclusion_conditions: The action is unrelated to the stated uncertainty.
The observation does not address the uncertainty being checked.
No specific uncertainty or assumption is identified in the reasoning.

uncertain.name: VERIFIES_POSTCONDITION_WITH_TARGETED_CHECK
uncertain.definition: After a change, the reasoning states an expected postcondition, a targeted action checks that postcondition, and the observation reports whether the expected state holds.

parameters.name: verification_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning specifying the postcondition to be verified after the change.

parameters.name: check_action
parameters.description: The action aimed at checking the stated postcondition.

parameters.name: check_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the result of the postcondition check.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning specifies a postcondition to be verified after the change.
The action is aimed at checking that postcondition rather than performing the change itself.
The observation reports a result that confirms or refutes the postcondition.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning is testing a pre-change uncertainty rather than a post-change expected state.
The action is unrelated to the stated postcondition.
The observation does not provide interpretable evidence about the postcondition.
Success is inferred only from executing the action.

uncertain.name: SELECTS_ACTION_BY_RISK_BENEFIT_ANALYSIS
uncertain.definition: The reasoning compares alternative courses of action with their risks and benefits, explicitly selects one course, and the action implements the selected course.

parameters.name: decision_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning comparing alternatives and selecting one course of action.

parameters.name: selected_action
parameters.description: The action implementing the selected course of action.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies at least two alternative courses of action.
The reasoning states risks, benefits, or tradeoffs that distinguish the alternatives.
The reasoning explicitly selects one course of action.
The action implements the selected course.
exclusion_conditions: Only one course of action is considered.
No risks, benefits, or tradeoffs are weighed.
The action does not correspond to the selected course.
